scripts.electron:dev: cross-env CHEM_CLIENT_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8080 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5000 concurrently -k "pnpm dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5000 && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:pack:win: cross-env CHEM_CLIENT_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8080 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.copy-dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src='dist',dst='../backend/static/dist';if(fs.existsSync(dst))fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst),{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('✓ 前端文件已复制到 backend/static/dist')"
